resolution_notes: example: INCORRECT (both verifiers right on response; path mostly fine). Official OpenAPI at https://docs.codecov.com/reference/repos_retrieve.md confirms GET /api/v2/{service}/{owner_username}/repos/{repo_name}/ on server https://api.codecov.io/api/v2/ — so github/OWNER/repos/REPO/ is valid. Auth header must be Authorization: bearer TOKEN (tokenAuth http bearer scheme in OpenAPI; docs overview also shows bearer), not Authorization: token. Response schema is Repo with name/private/totals/etc.; coverage lives at totals.coverage (CommitTotals), not top-level coverage — original snippet was fabricated. Sources: https://docs.codecov.com/reference/repos_retrieve.md , https://docs.codecov.com/reference/overview.md . No other fields disputed; left null.
